comment: System layer for the architecture graph. Each system groups files by REAL module paths (see generate.py --dump-tree). 'assign' entries are (crate lib-name, module prefix) pairs; a file joins the system whose prefix is the longest match. An entry with module "" is the crate-wide catch-all. Summaries describe what the modules contain, keyed to module names in code.
